status: Partial Gaping Maw implementation; no complete port accepted.

source_contracts.name: Gaping Maw

contract.movement: Stationary, solid room hazard; no pursuit or ordinary body-contact damage.
contract.targeting: Attracts player and both friendly and hostile projectiles toward its position.
contract.attacks: No shot emission; suction changes player movement and projectile trajectories.
contract.vulnerability: Immune to ordinary damage; solid to player movement even with flight. Chaos Card, Little Horn and Euthanasia are documented instant-kill exceptions. Generally respawns on room re-entry after such kills; Stone Eye has a distinct cleared-room re-entry rule. Generic XML HP is not ordinary damageability.
contract.phases: Active suction; pressure plates can deactivate it.
contract.offspring: No ordinary enemy offspring. Infestation 2 can create a Blue Spider on an exceptional kill; separate item dependency.
contract.completion: Does not seal doors; pressure-plate deactivation is documented, automatic ordinary combat-clear deactivation is not established.
contract.adaptations: No new runtime behavior or stage enablement in this review. Future 3D silhouette, obstacle footprint, projectile heights and timing must be declared DeathWard adaptations. Hazard placement needs its own budget and must not count as a kill-required enemy.
contract.unknowns: Exact native projectile speed, firing interval/selection, collision shape and effect-specific status/timing exceptions are not established. Pressure plates, instant-kill items, reroll behavior, re-entry and projectile-hit item hooks need concrete runtime support and tests. D10 is specifically documented to turn normal Gaping Maw into Broken Gaping Maw; other Grimaces have a reported invisible-solid reroll bug.

source_contracts.runtime_status: Source review only; existing generic definitions are unverified and no new encounter entries are enabled.

implemented: Continuous normal attraction; stronger Broken Maw attraction with a four-second active/four-second inactive cycle. Neither emits shots.

Planar player force participates in actual swept movement, mouse navigation, dodge and arrow aiming. Both projectile factions receive the same planar acceleration after ordinary guidance; vertical trajectory/gravity remains independent.
Reusable physical statue bodies, immunity to ordinary damage, pressure-plate shutdown, ordinary-clear persistence, exceptional respawn and retained cycle state during room re-entry.

Separate seeded hazard pools in bands 1–3 with one optional hazard per combat room; each Maw receives a reachable optional deactivation plate. No changes to ordinary actor budget, opening-band pools, tutorial or Mine roster.

adaptations.hp: Source 100 HP becomes 320 under the existing 3.2 conversion; ordinary invulnerability makes it bookkeeping, not weapon durability.
adaptations.forces: Normal peak player speed 2 units/s and projectile acceleration 12 units/s²; Broken 4 and 24. Range 24 units with linear falloff, vertical extent 4 units and projectile planar speed limit 40. Existing shots faster than the limit keep their incoming speed ceiling. These are local 3D values, not extracted Isaac constants.
adaptations.multiple_fields: Vectors sum and oppose each other, capped at the strongest participating configured peak. This local cap preserves movement counterplay and bounded acceleration; exact native stacking is unknown.
adaptations.collision: Player displacement is swept against ordinary world geometry and statue solids. Forces do not operate in corridors or inactive rooms. Physical input and aim remain under existing controls; stand-still does not cancel suction.
adaptations.cycle: Broken begins in its active half and alternates every four seconds. Cycle pauses while the room is inactive and resumes on return. Four-second period is sourced; startup phase and offscreen persistence are declared adaptations pending native measurement.
adaptations.visuals: Existing Original-style stone body with a larger dark mouth, Broken cracks and four small inward-moving dust motes; inactive phase closes the mouth. No source art imported.
adaptations.configuration: Forces, extents, cycle and pool weights are external. A current expedition retains its immutable content snapshot after edits.

unresolved: D10-to-Broken-Maw reroll requires a real item producer; generic replacement is not this interaction. Chaos Card, Euthanasia, Little Horn, Infestation 2, Dead Eye and Fire Mind dependencies remain open.
Source exact forces, distance curve, height behavior, stacking, startup phase and inactive-room timing remain unmeasured.
Full dedicated trap encounters, spikes around Maw placements and mixed-room encounter balance remain unfinished.
All-camera readability, human/varied-build balance and controlled Linux/WASM performance need acceptance evidence.
